scope: Independent forward-only screen. Only factored_screen.py and factored_screen.json written; no production/solver/test edits, inverse, prior, dependencies, model files, or stopping changes.

provenance.baseline: AST-extracted unmodified flat4_controls.homogenized_field/_frozen_field; native float64 formula cast checked bitwise against frozen float32 on EVERY solve
provenance.candidate_loading: Only 7 njit cache=True flags disabled in memory; arithmetic, iteration and tolerances unchanged
provenance.error_sign: numerical minus analytic reference; no demeaning or fitted offset

summary.timings_note: Candidate wall_seconds excludes JIT warmup. Baseline wall_seconds includes a second frozen float32 verification solve; use native_float64_seconds for single-solve comparisons.
summary.interpretation: Continuity, homogeneous exactness and iterative residual do NOT establish heterogeneous physical accuracy. Layered subregions and radial stress must be judged separately; no solver adjustment was made.

symmetry.scope: exact grid reflections/permutations, not arbitrary rotations; source avoids ambiguous interior cell faces

ulp.comparison_note: Fixed geometry/mask: positive homogeneous monotone discrete comparison predicts relative slowness stability; 1e-12 s is an explicit rounding allowance, not a physical accuracy tolerance.

layered.reference: Two planar layers z<750:2500 m/s, z>=750:5500 m/s; direct, Snell transmitted, critical head-wave minimum. Interfaces at voxel faces; source sphere entirely upper medium.
layered.caveat: Different grids sample different receiver centres; full-volume norms approximate continuum norms, not pointwise nested-grid errors. Nodal slowness averaging smears the interface; seed masks also change.

boundary.reference: Exact radial continuum T=min(r,R)/1000 + max(r-R,0)/6000; source on physical top boundary, slow hemisphere R=375 m.

cases.gross_early_threshold_note: Diagnostic 2h slowness-contrast allowance; NOT a rigorous discretization error bound. Also test the tighter analytic voxel-medium envelope below.

voxelization_envelope.explanation: Centre-labelled voxel medium contains the slow ball R-halfdiag and lies within slow ball R+halfdiag. Their exact radial times bound continuum travel in that voxel medium. This is not a theorem for the nodal averaged finite-difference operator.
